title: Scripture and Discipleship
definition: Scripture and discipleship belong together because disciples of Jesus are formed, corrected, equipped, and sent by the Word of God.
summary: Disciples grow as Scripture teaches them to follow Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus commands His followers to make disciples by teaching obedience to all He commanded.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Discipleship is not built on personality, trends, or vague spirituality. It is built under the teaching of Christ and the whole counsel of God.

Scripture trains disciples in doctrine, worship, holiness, mission, endurance, relationships, and hope. It shapes both what believers believe and how they live.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Without Scripture, discipleship becomes shallow advice or personality-driven influence. This doctrine matters because followers of Jesus must be formed by His Word.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Make Scripture central to your growth and your ministry to others. Teach, discuss, memorize, apply, and obey the Word in the normal rhythms of discipleship.
